items.html: And you must know that behold, the lower man, male or female, is not hinted, in their image and likeness, at a particular aspect — as at Tifferet alone, or at Malchut alone, and the like. However, every man hints at the entire world of Atzilut, from the head of AA to the end of the Malchut of Atzilut, like AA himself, whose ten Sefirot expand throughout the whole world of Atzilut, as mentioned.
